elo: Elo: a team-strength rating updated after every game, scaled by margin of victory. 1500 is average; 100 points is roughly a 64% win chance on a neutral court.
kalman: Kalman rating: team strength in points per game versus an average team, with an uncertainty that grows between games and shrinks as results come in.
sd: ±SD: one standard deviation of the rating's uncertainty. About two thirds of the time the true strength lies within this band.
adjusted_net: Adjusted net: points scored minus allowed per 100 possessions, adjusted for opponent strength and home court.
healthy_current: Healthy is the team's strength with everyone available; Current removes injured players weighted by their status. The gap is the injury deficit.
fair_line: Fair line: the moneyline that matches the model's win probability with no bookmaker margin.
overround: Overround: how much the bookmaker's implied probabilities add up to above 100%. That excess is the bookmaker's margin.
edge: Edge: model probability minus the market's fair (de-vigged) probability. Positive means the model rates the side higher than the market.
kelly: Kelly: the stake, as a % of bankroll, that maximises long-run growth at this price. Shown as a fraction of full Kelly and capped. Not betting advice.
brier: Brier score: mean squared error of the win probabilities. Lower is better; always saying 50% scores 0.25.
log_loss: Log loss: penalises confident wrong forecasts heavily. Lower is better; a coin flip scores 0.693.
calibration_gap: Calibration gap: actual win rate minus the average forecast in a probability band. Near zero means the probabilities can be taken at face value.
within_3: Within 3: the chance the final margin is 3 points or fewer either way, from the Monte Carlo simulation.
